A '''[[Science droid/Legends|science droid]]''' was stationed inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
After [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] staged "[[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]" around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this science [[Droid/Legends|droid]] helped [[Gender/Legends|him]] shave his head and administered him an injection to help him transform into [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].
